Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the notification for the Post Of 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE. This recruitment has been issued for 326 posts. Online applying process for Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Recruitment 2026 will start from 05 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 04 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 August 2026
  • Last Date : 04 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 September 2026
  • Correction Date: 06-08 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, BC, EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 50/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 04 September 2026.
